description: StEER - Hurricane Dorian: Field Assessment Structural Team (FAST) Dataset is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This dataset includes door-to-door damage assessments and aerial and terrestrial imagery collected by StEER Field Assessment Structural Teams (FASTs) responding to the passage of Hurricane Dorian over the Bahamas. The data was collected in two missions, September 24-25 and October 5-8, 2019. Coverage: The Bahamas. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: StEER, Reconnaissance, Hurricane, Dorian, Grand Bahama Island, Great Abaco Island. Published 2022-09-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
